root.name: Scotch Game: Romanishin Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 Bc5 5. Nb3 Bb4+

overview: In the Potter Scotch Black checks with 5...Bb4+ instead of the main 5...Bb6. White blocks with 6.c3 and Black retreats with ...Ba5 or ...Bd6 while White builds with Nc3, Bd3 and O-O. White has space and the centre, Black has played the bishop three times and relies on solid development. I am not sure of the main line.

white_ideas.idea: Block the check and keep the centre with c3, Bd3, O-O
Use space and the pawn on e4

black_ideas.idea: Retreat the bishop to a5 or d6 and play ...d6 or ...d5

typical_structures.structure: White e4/c3 centre against bishop on a5 or d6
Open-ish Scotch lines with minor pieces

character.notes: Quiet manoeuvring after the check with limited forcing play.

gambit.notes: Material is level and nothing is attacked yet.

structure.notes: The centre is partly open after the d-pawn trade.
